noah: Heads-up - small but reproducible issue on int4 canary: we9re seeing duplicate func_call emissions in ~2.7% of mirrored sessions. Not parse errors, but the call-adapter receives two function-starts with different transient ids.
hema: I noticed that too in mirrored logs. Both payloads are semantically the same but chunk boundaries differ, so strict byte-equality dedupe fails.
jorge: Do we have timing distribution? Is second emission usually immediate or after a retry?
noah: Median delta ~110ms, long tail to 4s. Correlates with sessions where first-call token emission was delayed (KV warmup spikes).
iris: Hypothesis: runtime-side retry triggers while generator is still streaming tokens. Adapter gets a reissue and later the continued stream emits same func_call. Our dedupe relies on request_id which changes across retries.
hema: Quick repro excerpt (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-05T11:12:01Z] recv chunk session=sess42 seq=0 {"fn":"get_user","args":{"id":"u123"},"_chunk":"t=0..22"}
[2026-03-05T11:12:01Z] runtime: retry due to ack_timeout temp_id=tmpA
[2026-03-05T11:12:01Z] recv chunk session=sess42 seq=1 {"fn":"get_user","args":{"id":"u123"},"_chunk":"t=0..58"}
```
Two reconstructions, same semantic call, different temp ids.
jorge: Short-term fix: implement semantic fingerprinting in call-adapter. Steps: canonicalize args JSON (sorted keys, trim insignificant whitespace, unify escape sequences, strip trailing commas) then hash (xxhash64). Dedupe by (fingerprint, window=6s).
iris: Add safeguard: compute arg-diff; if normalized edit distance > 0.02, treat as different and don9t dedupe. Emit metric suppressed_retry when we intentionally skip dedupe.
hema: Also keep raw+repaired artifacts for ~100 failures so we can iterate canonicalizers. Don9t overwrite raw logs.
noah: Long-term: move idempotency token generation into server runtime so retries keep same id across replays. That avoids heuristic matching.
jorge: Plan: run AB test on raven-int4-canary at 1% traffic with fp_dedupe flag enabled for 12h. Measure duplicate_tool_start rate, suppressed_retry rate, and request latency. If dup rate drops <0.3% and no adverse impacts, promote.
iris: I'll wire a harness to mirror pipeline: sample 15k sessions, label duplicates, compute tokenization deltas and first-call latency. Will store 200 raw+repaired artifacts in restricted bucket.
hema: Deploy-bot: kick canary with fp_dedupe=true at 1% for raven-int4-canary if infra green.
ci-bot: @hema Deployment requested: raven-int4-canary fp_dedupe=true at 1% traffic. Queued.
offline: NOTE: ensure downstream tool servers are idempotent for duplicate tool_start events. Add quick circuit breaker for heavy ops.
noah: OK. Action items:
- iris: harness + initial metrics (first 250k mirrored reqs)
- jorge: upload fingerprint algorithm CL and tests by EOD
- hema: start AB and monitor dashboard tile for duplicate_tool_start
- noah: draft rollback/playbook if latency or error rate rises
If anything spikes, abort AB and revert.
hema: Will update this thread with first numbers.
noah: Thanks all. Closing for now.
